in_hindi.name: नहरावान
in_hindi.meaning: एक प्रसिद्ध स्थान जिसमें एक बड़ी नदी है नहरावान, इराक में स्थित है

in_pashto.name: نهراوان

data.cultural_impact: Nahrawan holds significant cultural importance in Islamic history. It is mentioned in various hadiths (sayings of the prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him) as one of the many rivers in Paradise. This name is often used as a symbol of peace, serenity, and tranquility within Islamic and Arabic literature, poetry, and art.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, the name Nahrawan represents a deeper spiritual meaning. It is an allusion to the river that flows in Paradise, where the faithful will drink from and be refreshed after their long journey in the world. The name reminds Muslims of the promise of eternal peace and serenity in the afterlife, and serves as a source of comfort and motivation for believers to endure the hardships of life and strive towards righteousness.
